title: GrindrPlus target Grindr version metadata
description: The single source of truth for which Grindr (com.grindrapp.android) version this module targets. Updated by fetch_version.py; read by app/build.gradle.kts to set grindrVersionName/grindrVersionCode.

versionName.description: Grindr's semantic version (X.Y.Z). Mirrors the value APKMirror exposes for the latest com.grindrapp.android release.

versionCode.description: Grindr's build number (positive integer). Mirrors the value APKMirror exposes for the latest com.grindrapp.android release.
